name: IPP_ARELLE_PARSE
inputs: g0-r/R07-raw-retrieval IPP_XBRL artefacts (15): ipp-{SAN,BBVA,IBE}-{I,II}-semestre-de-{2024,2025,2026}.zip (raw XML instances; .zip suffix is a storage name, not an archive)
g0-r/R10-taxonomy-pinning: cnmv-ipp-2019-01-01-opencnmv-pkg.zip (locally-assembled package: pinned CNMV flat zip + pinned xbrl.org base schemas; member provenance in ipp_pkg_members.json)
outputs: R10 addendum: pin_ipp_pkg.py, evidence/cnmv-ipp-2019-01-01-opencnmv-pkg.zip, evidence/ipp_pkg_members.json, +2 xbrl.org pin rows in taxonomy_manifest.json

sha256.note: per-output evidence hashes (facts.jsonl, oim.json.gz, arelle-log.json) in each {FID}.model_summary.json

findings: All 15 IPP instances load fully offline under Arelle 2.44.0 with the pinned IPP taxonomy package: DTS complete (14 docs), ioerr=0, zero download attempts, zero warnings/errors.

Coverage deliberate: ipp_en credit-entity model (SAN, BBVA), ipp_ge general model (IBE), H1 and H2, all five corpus slots. ipp_en DTS=1262 concepts vs ipp_ge=869 - real model heterogeneity, preserved.
Fact preservation verified: QName, value/xValue, context (entity, period), unit, decimals, nil, explicit AND typed dimensions (1-16 typed-dim contexts per filing - absent in ESEF corpus), language.
Control A (Arelle Python API vs Arelle saveLoadableOIM xBRL-JSON): normalized fact multisets equal, concept coverage equal, decimals/nil equal for all 15 filings.

Arelle limitation: lexicalPatterns['base64Binary'] nested-quantifier regex raises MemoryError on ~8MB embedded-PDF base64Binary facts (also present in 2.45.0). Harness substitutes a linear-time validator that is version-gated (arelle-release==2.44.0) and fingerprint-gated (orig pattern sha256); equivalence proven at install vs the original pattern object (40 curated + 4000 fuzz + 12MB payload); fails loudly on upstream change. Raw facts preserved; re-run reproduced byte-identical facts.jsonl on 15/15.
Raw IPP artefacts carry a .zip suffix while being XML instances; Arelle treats .zip as archive - entrypoint fed as byte-identical .xbrl copy (sha256 verified, deleted post-run).

R10 amended by R12: CNMV flat zip re-wrapped as a taxonomy package; xl-2003-12-31.xsd and xlink-2003-12-31.xsd (transitive imports of xbrl-linkbase) pinned; every DTS doc resolves from the package - no per-user Arelle cache dependence.
R10 taxonomy_manifest now distinguishes OFFICIAL_TAXONOMY_RAW (19) vs OPEN_CNMV_DERIVED_TAXONOMY_PACKAGE (4) via the `kind` field.
limitations: Lexical shim replaces only the base64Binary XSD lexical pattern (not XBRL semantics); version+fingerprint gated, aborts on upstream change; equivalence self-tested against the original pattern object at every run.
ipp package /se/ and /ti/ paths inferred by analogy; only /en/ and /ge/ exercised by the frozen corpus.
No second-parser control on IPP (Brel is a partial iXBRL/ESEF oracle per R11); adapter bounded by Control A only.
OIM comparison uses xBRL-JSON; OIM-CSV equivalence transitive via the same Arelle model.
